story:
It was a sunny day at Sunshine Elementary School. Soomin was so excited to show off his brand-new, shiny lunchbox in his classroom. But when he went to grab it from his hook, oh no! It wasn't there!

"Mom, I lost my new lunchbox!" Soomin cried out to his mom on the phone.

Ms. Johnson, their kind teacher, heard Soomin's worry and came over to give him a warm hug. "Don't worry, Soomin! We'll find it together with your friends."

Soomin's best friend, Emma, jumped up from her seat. "I want to help too!" she said.

Emma suggested they search the classroom first. As they looked around, they noticed the playful class parrot, Sunny, chirping loudly on his perch. Emma giggled and whispered to Soomin, "Maybe Sunny saw something!"

The friends carefully approached Sunny's cage. To their surprise, a small piece of paper was stuck between two toys! It had a clue written in crayon: "Look near the big, old oak tree outside for your lunchbox!"

Soomin's eyes widened with excitement. "Wow! Let's go on an adventure!" he exclaimed.

As they walked out to the playground, Soomin tripped on a small rock and dropped his backpack. Emma quickly helped him pick up all his things. "Don't worry, I've got your back!" she said with a smile.

When they reached the big oak tree, there it was! Soomin's shiny lunchbox was nestled between two branches!

Soomin beamed with joy. "Yay! My lunchbox is found!"

Ms. Johnson and Emma cheered along with him. As they walked back to the classroom together, Soomin turned to Emma and said, "Thanks for helping me find my lunchbox. You're the best friend ever!"

Emma grinned back at Soomin. "Anytime, buddy! We make a great team."

The friends high-fived each other and headed back inside for a yummy snack together.
